For Job code NTS002

[/eikra-vc-text-title][vc_column_text]
The Job: Instructor & Assistant Instructors
Education: Diploma /B. Tech in relevant branch with 1st class
Experience:                                2-3 years
Location: Mysuru
Employment Type: Permanent
Roles and Responsibilities:
  • Make a list of components & equipment for the upcoming lab in consultation with faculty in charge of lab, Foreman & HOD.
  • Arrange for demonstration of new equipment purchase if any, in consultation with Foreman and faculty in-charge.
  • Check the quality of equipment and certify, after purchase of equipment
  • Identify weak students by the end of the first month and report the list to faculty in-charge.
  • Schedule additional classes for the weak students in consultation with Foreman and faculty in-charge.
  • Monitor the progress of the students and ensure students reach the required level of competency before the end of second month.
  • Help the students in the implementation of mini projects & Projects.
  • Assist the faculty in the preparation of the lab manual.
  • Test the lab experiments one month before the commencement of the semester.
  • Providing guidance & assistance to students to do mini projects & projects.
  • Design & develop required material for the smooth conduction of the lab.
  • Upload the lab videos two weeks before the commencement of the semester.
  • Coordinating with Internship program.
  • Assisting faculty in preparing the content for virtual lab
  • Assist the faculty with the assigned work.
  • Maintain the logbook.
  • Maintain the stock register.
  • Check the working of equipment within 15 days after the last working day and get the servicing done if required either in-house or from an external agency.
  • Get the calibration of equipment done within 15days after the last working day of the semester.
  • Prepare charts/ boards required for the upcoming labs within three weeks after the last working day.
  • Display the lab timetable, list of students, list of experiments, and lab cycle in the notice board.
  • Assist foreman to prepare documents during the examination.
  • Coordinate and provide support in Department & Institution related activities
  • Assist, coordinate & provide support in Department & institutional related events.
  • Taking active participation in providing assistance to the administrators of the Institution
  • Assisting faculty in writing proposals for funding.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row]
